import subprocess, sys, json, os
from pathlib import Path

script='/work/batch.py'
scenarios=['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']

for sc in scenarios:
    inp='\n' if sc=='live' else None
    cp=subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, sc], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True)
    stderr_lines=[ln for ln in cp.stderr.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    parsed=[]
    ok_json=True
    for ln in stderr_lines:
        try:
            parsed.append(json.loads(ln))
        except Exception:
            ok_json=False
            break
    seq_ok=False
    if ok_json:
        seq=[r.get('sequence') for r in parsed]
        seq_ok=seq==list(range(len(parsed))) and all(isinstance(x,int) for x in seq)
    print(f'[{sc}] exit={cp.returncode} stdout_bytes={len(cp.stdout.encode())} stderr_records={len(stderr_lines)} json={ok_json} seq_ok={seq_ok}')
    if ok_json and parsed:
        print('  first_event=',parsed[0].get('event'),'last_event=',parsed[-1].get('event'),'summary_seq=',parsed[-1].get('sequence'))

import subprocess, sys, json

script='/work/batch.py'
scenarios=['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']
expected_exit={'normal':0,'mixed':1,'partial-zero':0,'empty':0,'unknown':0,'fail-fast':1,'cancelled':130,'live':0}

for sc in scenarios:
    kwargs=dict(text=True,capture_output=True)
    if sc=='live':
        kwargs['input']='\n'
    cp=subprocess.run([sys.executable, script, sc], **kwargs)
    assert cp.returncode==expected_exit[sc], (sc, cp.returncode)
    records=[json.loads(ln) for ln in cp.stderr.splitlines() if ln.strip()]
    seq=[r['sequence'] for r in records]
    assert seq==list(range(len(records))), (sc, seq)
    print(f'{sc}: exit={cp.returncode}, stderr_records={len(records)}, stdout_len={len(cp.stdout)}')
print('all scenario checks passed')
